subtitle: A fast glossary of everything so far

code:
Org           your company's isolated environment
Multitenancy  shared infra, data isolated per org
Instance      the server cluster your org runs on
Edition       product tier (Essentials...Developer)
License       per-user access grant
Metadata      the blueprint behind an org's behavior
Release       platform upgrade, 3x a year

code:
Object      a type of thing tracked (Account...)
Record      one instance of an object
Field       one piece of info on a record
App         a bundle of tabs for one job
Tab         a link to one object's records
List view   a filtered, sorted table of records
Home page   an app's landing dashboard
